projects.truekapp_desc: Truekapp is a full-featured web application built with Laravel that allows users to exchange items through a real-time bartering system. It includes offer management, instant chat with WebSockets, and an admin panel for content moderation. The project was developed collaboratively with other developers, where I specialized in the real-time messaging system integration and notification logic.
projects.valorant_desc: One of my first projects working with external APIs. I developed a website that consumes the Valorant API, where users can browse characters along with their abilities, and I added a theme toggle button (light/dark mode) to enhance the visual experience.
projects.managepoint_desc: ManagePoint is a professional web platform built for salon and staff management, optimizing internal processes and facilitating historical tracking and reporting. For privacy reasons, all names and data shown in this video are fictional. It includes an admin panel, user management, version control, and PDF report generation, all fully developed and functional.
